name: Suriclone
summary: Suriclone (Suril) is a sedative and anxiolytic drug in the cyclopyrrolone family of drugs. Other cyclopyrrolone drugs include zopiclone and pagoclone.

pharmacology.text: The mechanism of action by which suriclone produces its sedative and anxiolytic effects is by modulating GABAA receptors, although suriclone is more subtype-selective than most benzodiazepines.

uses.en: It was developed and studied as a medicine for anxiety.
uses.zh: 它被開發並研究作為治療焦慮的藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它被开发并研究作为治疗焦虑的药物。

sideEffects.en: Little detail on its side effects has been published. Related drugs such as zopiclone can cause drowsiness, poor coordination, memory problems and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 關於它的副作用，已發表的細節很少。佐匹克隆等相關藥物可能造成嗜睡、協調變差、記憶問題與依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 关于它的副作用，已发表的细节很少。佐匹克隆等相关药物可能造成嗜睡、协调制差、记忆问题与依赖。

fact.en: Suriclone is a cyclopyrrolone from Rhône-Poulenc, the French company that also made the sleeping pill zopiclone, and it was given the trade name Suril.
fact.zh: Suriclone是羅納普朗克公司的環吡咯酮類藥物，這家法國公司也開發了安眠藥佐匹克隆，它的商品名為Suril。
fact.zhHans: Suriclone是罗纳普朗克公司的环吡咯酮类药物，这家法国公司也开发了安眠药佐匹克隆，它的商品名为Suril。
